name: Noom
title: noom.com
shortDescription: Noom focuses on helping users achieve long-term weight loss through psychological approaches and mindful eating. It's designed for individuals seeking sustainable health improvements rather than quick fixes. Users can expect to lose 1-2 lbs per week by following the Noom plan, which incorporates guidance from scientific research and personalized coaching.
pros: Psychologically based approach to weight loss
Evidence-based results with references to scientific studies
cons: Results may vary significantly per individual
Some parts of the website may not function without cookies
